events.name: The Road Is Closed
events.intro: A Rocket barricade across the road: "Closed for inventory." The detour is long, and the grunts have not seen you yet.

success.text: It costs you an hour and a bit of nerve, nothing else.
Two grunts come out of the van.
The barricade lifts. The receipt says INSURANCE.

events.name: The Shop Is Taken
events.intro: The Poké Mart has a Rocket sign over the door and half its shelves bare. A grunt behind the counter: "New management."

success.text: A few Potions at triple the sign price. It is still a shop.
The grunt calls for a friend.
You find the owner out back, who points you to the next town's shop.

events.name: Blackout
events.intro: The lights go out across the block. A voice on a loudspeaker: "Power is a privilege. Accuracy is, too." Your Pokémon will fight at a disadvantage in the dark: moves miss more often tonight.

choices.label: Wait for dawn at the Center

success.text: You sit out the dark. The power is back by morning and your party is rested.
Accuracy is down 10% in this fight. It is announced, and you can still back out.
You trace the cable to a grunt's van and pull the plug. The lights come back, and so does their patience.

events.name: Requisition
events.intro: A grunt with a clipboard is "requisitioning" a Pokémon Center's supplies: bandages, Potions, a cot. The nurse looks at you.

success.text: The Requisition Squad does not take it well.
The clipboard gets its tick. The nurse keeps her cots.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Leader's Announcement
events.intro: Every screen in town shows the same face. "Citizens, from tonight the Ledger is simply how things are done." The crowd goes quiet. Nothing else happens, and there is nothing to fight.

success.text: You learn what the Ledger now covers, and who is nervous about it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Checkpoint
events.intro: Two grunts and a folding table: "Papers." Everyone ahead of you is being let through for a small fee.

success.text: "Fine. Go." They do not look at what they are waving through.
The table goes over.
The table is moved an inch.

events.name: The Poached Meadow
events.intro: The tall grass is flattened in neat rows. A trapper is loading cages into a truck with a red R on the side.

success.text: The trapper does not give up the key.
You mark where the truck stops. It helps the next person who cares.
The Ranger takes the note and thanks you.

events.name: Supply Line
events.intro: A convoy of three vans, one lead grunt. They are ferrying the supplies that keep the Ledger funded. A win here would make the world a little easier.

success.text: Three fights in a row, no healing between them. A win turns the Ledger back one step.
A few well-placed nails in a tire. The convoy is late, not stopped.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: What the Baker Heard
events.intro: A baker slides you a warm roll. "Heard the shop on Elm is paying 'insurance' now. For what? Nobody says."

success.text: She tells you which shop, and when the Collector comes by.
It is a good roll. Your party shares it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Queue
events.intro: A queue around the block for a Center that opens two hours a night. People have brought chairs.

choices.label: Give up your place to someone with a sick Pokémon

success.text: A woman thanks you three times. Your party does not mind the wait.
Two hours later, a rested party.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Back-Door Shop
events.intro: A shopkeeper waves you into a stockroom. "The front door is watched. Here, it's the old prices. Quick."

success.text: Potions and a ball, at honest prices.

choices.label: Tell him you will not be a customer

success.text: He shrugs. "Then you were never here."

events.name: Black-Label
events.intro: The prize counter at the Game Corner has new labels: BLACK. A boy stares at a plush he can no longer afford.

success.text: He hugs it and will not stop thanking you.

choices.label: Ask the counter who made the new labels

success.text: The counter goes quiet. You write it down.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Street That Left
events.intro: Half a street of shutters, a notice taped to each: GONE WITH THE EXPORT. A boy sits on a step holding a Poké Ball that nobody will answer.

success.text: He tells you what his Pokémon was like. It is a long story, and a good one.
He takes them with both hands.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Under New Management
events.intro: A restaurant has a new sign: UNDER NEW MANAGEMENT. The old owner is washing the windows anyway.

success.text: "The menu. The prices. Who I am allowed to serve." He gives you a note for the next town.
The food is fine. The silence is not.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Rocket Advert
events.intro: Every screen in the plaza runs a jingle: "Team Rocket: Insuring Your Peace of Mind." People hum it without noticing.

success.text: A grunt notices. You have a head start.
You catch the number at the bottom. It is a tip line.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Letter Home
events.intro: A woman asks if you can carry a letter to her sister in the next town. Post is "slow" these days.

success.text: You will remember the name on the envelope.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Closed Gym Door
events.intro: A dojo is shuttered. A black belt sweeps the step anyway. "My students stopped coming. Somebody is telling them it is not safe."

success.text: A friendly bout. He teaches you something about breathing.

choices.label: Promise to tell the town it is safe

success.text: You do, at the next stop. The town thinks about it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Name It Out Loud
events.intro: Everyone in the square knows what is wrong and nobody says it. A child asks you, loudly, what the Ledger is.

success.text: The square goes still, and then a few people nod. It is not much. It is a start.
She frowns. You walk on.

events.name: An Officer With a Name
events.intro: A woman in a pressed uniform stops you. "I am Officer Hale of the team's planning office. I do not usually leave my desk, and I would like to be done quickly."

success.text: She offers a trade: leave the next shipment alone and she will leave you alone. You do not answer yet.
A Lieutenant's party, no more.
"A pity," she says, and means it.

events.name: The Familiar Face
events.intro: A man in a team uniform is not wearing his hat right. You know him from somewhere. He knows you too. "I took this job after the factory closed."

choices.label: Tell him he does not have to stay

success.text: He looks at the ground. "Where would I go?" You tell him about the next town, and who is hiring.
He fights like someone who would rather not.

choices.label: Pretend you do not know him

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Handler and Hound
events.intro: A Handler walks a big, quiet Pokémon on a short lead. It looks at you, once. "This is a trained line," she says. "Do not make me prove it."

success.text: She tells you more than she meant to: how it is trained and what it will not do. You write it down.
The Handler and her Pokémon, announced before the first move.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Inside Man Appears
events.intro: A grunt keeps falling behind his patrol and looking at you. When the others turn a corner he says it fast: "I am on your side. I cannot say more."

success.text: He slips you a note and walks off. It is a time and a door.
He loses on purpose. You are not sure whether that is better or worse.

choices.label: Do not trust anyone in that uniform

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Inside Man Warns
events.intro: The Inside Man catches your sleeve. "Tonight the Collectors are out in force. Do not go by the main road."

success.text: You avoid a patrol and an awkward conversation.

choices.label: Go by the main road anyway

success.text: The patrol is waiting, exactly as he said.

events.name: The Inside Man Is Caught
events.intro: Two lieutenants are walking your Inside Man down an alley, hands on his shoulders.

success.text: You get him free, and a promise to keep quiet.
A dropped crate of balls. He runs. You pay for the crate.
You hear nothing more from him.

events.name: The Runner
events.intro: A kid runs past with a satchel and does not stop. He drops one thing as he turns the corner: an envelope with no name. Nothing chases him. Nothing needs to.

success.text: A hand-drawn map. One building is circled twice.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Honor Guard
events.intro: Four black-clad guards stand in a square outside a district gate. They salute you, crisply. "Orders are orders."

success.text: A tough fight; one district is easier to hold if you win.
One of them lowers his hand. The gate stays open for you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Tag Removed
events.intro: A Pokémon wears a black tag on its ear, plainly. A volunteer with a pair of snips is working her way along a fence of cages.

success.text: One tag comes off; the Pokémon walks out of the cage and does not look back.
A line number and a lot code. You write them down.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Trait Overheard
events.intro: Two grunts argue about whose Pokémon is the better "line". One brags about its signature trait and how nothing can stop it.

success.text: You catch the trait and its one weakness.
They both turn on you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: One Left Behind
events.intro: A hideout has been cleared in a hurry. One Pokémon is still in the corner, tagged, shivering, unclaimed.

success.text: It joins you for the road. It is wary, but it follows.
Nobody comes. You leave water and a note.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: One Returned
events.intro: A grunt in civilian clothes stands outside a Center holding a ball in both hands. "I took this from a trainer. It never worked right for me. Do you know whose it is?"

choices.label: Take it and find the owner

success.text: You carry it to the next town. A girl is waiting. She cries.

choices.label: Tell him to hand it in himself

success.text: He nods. He goes in.

events.name: A Signature, Seen
events.intro: On a rooftop across the street, a Pokémon you do not know practises one move, over and over. The glow before it hits is unmistakable.

success.text: You learn the glow and the warning that comes before it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Stolen Egg
events.intro: A grunt is carrying a warm egg wrapped in a jacket. He sees you and runs.

success.text: He trips on a root and the egg rolls free.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Training Yard
events.intro: A fenced yard where recruits train their Pokémon. A drill sergeant waves you in. "Free spar, no tricks. Nobody keeps score."

choices.label: Spar for the fun of it

success.text: A hard hour. Your lead comes away sharper.
You pick up a trick or two.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Name on a Crate
events.intro: A stack of crates, each stencilled with a name and a number. One of the names is the same as a Pokémon you once lost.

success.text: The number matches an entry in a ledger you have heard about.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Grateful One
events.intro: A Pokémon you helped earlier turns up on a ledge, a little thinner and a little braver. It brings you something it found.

success.text: A berry and a long look. It stays near for a while.

choices.label: Thank it and let it go

success.text: It trots off, satisfied.

events.name: The Signature Move, Rehearsed
events.intro: From a roof you watch the finale's own Apex rehearse its signature move, with an engineer calling the warning line. You can read both from here.

success.text: You now know what it says, and what it means.

choices.label: Mark one part of the move

success.text: You note the part that matters most: it is where the engineer's eyes go.

events.name: They Have Come for One of Yours
events.intro: A whistle, three times, from the roof. Two grunts step out with a transport case: "That one belongs to the team. We have come to collect." This is the Reclaim attempt, announced before it begins.

success.text: Announced: a win ends the Reclaim. A loss follows the standard defeat rule.
They take the money and leave. They will be back, quieter.

choices.label: Slip away before they close the street

success.text: You lose the whistle in a crowd. They lose your trail.

events.name: The Surge
events.intro: A transmitter on a pole starts to hum, and your Shadow Pokémon looks up. This is the Surge, announced: it will stir your Shadow Pokémon for one fight.

success.text: A technician guards the box.

choices.label: Lead your party away from it

success.text: You walk three streets before the hum fades. Your party is unsettled but fine.

choices.label: Wait it out in a quiet doorway

success.text: It passes.

events.name: Snag!
events.intro: A grunt with a strange glove squares up to you, and the glove has a ball in it. Announced: this is a Snag attempt on one of your Pokémon. Switching dodges it.

success.text: The ball hits the pavement. You keep the Pokémon.
He gets one throw; a win ends it.
You are faster. Mostly.

events.name: A Bound Pokémon
events.intro: A wild Pokémon is chained to a stake, ringed by grunts. It looks at you and does not growl.

success.text: The ring breaks when you do.
A bolt cutter from a stall. The Pokémon walks off into the grass.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: An Officer Throws Down
events.intro: A lieutenant leans on a lamp post as you pass. "Your Shadow Pokémon is a team asset. I would like to see how it fights without you telling it what to do."

success.text: A fair fight, announced; your Shadow Pokémon may hesitate, and you will see why.
"Afraid to see it?" You walk on.

events.name: A Key Turns
events.intro: Your Shadow Pokémon stops in the middle of the road and looks at a particular door. It remembers something. This is the moment a key is close. No fight is needed; this is a scene.

success.text: Behind the door is a small thing that matters. Your Pokémon relaxes for the first time in days.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Long Walk
events.intro: A road with no towns on it. Your Shadow Pokémon walks easier on this one.

success.text: A day of nothing in particular. Corruption eases by 3.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Shared Table
events.intro: A table in a plaza, set for strangers. A woman waves you over: "Sit. Everyone eats."

success.text: A long meal, nobody keeping score. Corruption eases by 8.
A bite, and a thank-you. Corruption eases by 3.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Crowd Chant
events.intro: A street fair, a drum, and a chant that everyone knows. The chant is about being let in.

success.text: You and your Shadow Pokémon are in the circle for ten minutes. Corruption eases by 12.
You watch from a bench. Corruption eases by 2.

events.name: The Bridge of Lamps
events.intro: A bridge lit with paper lamps. The whole town walks it once a year, thinking of someone.

choices.label: Cross it slowly with your Shadow Pokémon

success.text: A hush, and the lamps; corruption eases by 15.
It is pretty. Nothing else happens.

events.name: A Key Hinted
events.intro: Your Shadow Pokémon nudges the same object three times: an old jacket in a shop window.

success.text: The shopkeeper asks no questions. Your Pokémon rests its head on it.
You write down the shop's name.

events.name: Stabilize, or Not
events.intro: A quiet doctor offers to Stabilize your Shadow Pokémon: not purify, only steady. It would keep its Shadow traits and stop sliding. He says you can decide later.

success.text: He is honest: it will not be fully free. It will be safe.
"Of course. The offer stays open."

events.name: Purified Water
events.intro: A spring with a hand-painted sign: DRINK, IF YOU LIKE. A Pokémon you do not know laps at it.

success.text: Cool and plain. Your party is a little better for it.
You take a Full Heal-sized bottle, no charge.

events.name: A Key Missed
events.intro: You pass the place your Shadow Pokémon's key points to, and by the time you notice, the shop has closed and the street is empty. Nothing is lost; the key waits.

success.text: You mark the spot. The key will still be there.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Man With the Clipboard
events.intro: A thin man with a clipboard writes down every Pokémon that passes the crossroads, yours included. He does not look up. This is a scene, not a fight.

success.text: "Throughput," he says. Then he writes down your question.
Columns of numbers, and a header: CIPHER, ACCOUNT 2.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Samples
events.intro: A numbered crate is being loaded into a van, and the liaison is signing for it. The crate is the first shipment of Samples: if it leaves, the Stock grows.

success.text: A loader and a driver, no more. A win stops the crate.
A flat tire, a long argument. The crate does not leave tonight.
The van pulls out. The Stock grows by one step.

events.name: A Demonstration
events.intro: The liaison is showing a buyer something in a locked room, and the buyer is impressed. You see a lit window.

success.text: A guard and a demonstrator.
You are too far to hear. You are close enough to see the buyer's face.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Invoice
events.intro: A courier hands you an envelope by mistake. Inside: an invoice for "Services, Region (partial)", with a line item you recognise. No fight, no hurry.

choices.label: Read it all the way through

success.text: Names, amounts, and a signature you will see again.

choices.label: Give it back to the courier

success.text: He thanks you, and does not meet your eye.

events.name: Late Fee
events.intro: A collector for the liaison taps his watch. "Overdue." He wants a copy of the Data ROM you hold, and he will take it by force. A lost fight never costs the ROM: a copy is all anyone can take.

success.text: A win and he leaves you alone.
He signs off. The ROM stays with you.
He copies it on the spot. The original stays in your hand.

events.name: The Postcard From Elsewhere
events.intro: A postcard with no stamp is slipped under your door. It shows the next region on your road. On the back, in a neat hand: SEE YOU THERE.

success.text: You keep it, face up, in your notebook.
You do not look at it again.

events.name: A Crate Number
events.intro: A stencilled number on an empty crate in an alley: 00-17-A. The same number is on a van parked two blocks away.

success.text: It leads to a warehouse you will remember.
You write it on your hand and wash it off later.

events.name: A Maker's Plate
events.intro: A discarded machine with a brass plate: BUILT FOR CIPHER, SERIES 2. A tinkerer is trying to buy it for scrap.

success.text: He puts it down, shaken. He thanks you for the warning.
A cold bit of brass, and a name.

events.name: A Waveform on a Napkin
events.intro: A napkin on a café table, a waveform drawn in pen. Someone drew it while thinking about something else.

success.text: You show it to someone who knows. It matches a signal at the Silph tower.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Meowth Reads a Stencil
events.intro: A talking Meowth is reading a stencil on a van, mouthing it. He sees you. "Don't say nothing."

success.text: He reads it out. It is a delivery window. He asks you not to use it.
He eats it. "I ain't sayin' nothin', but thanks."

events.name: The Clipboard, Unattended
events.intro: A clipboard lies on a bench. Nobody is near it.

success.text: Counts, timings, a map. Everything on it is a request for numbers.

choices.label: Move it where its owner can find it

success.text: Better to be decent than clever.

events.name: A Copy
events.intro: A courier is carrying a Data ROM identical to yours. Hers is a copy. Yours is the only original.

success.text: "The Boss's supplier," she says, then regrets saying it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Debt Repaid
events.intro: Three figures in dark coats and a talking Meowth stand in the shade of a vending machine. "We owe you," says one. "We never said we would pay."

success.text: They carry a heavy crate of supplies for you, then vanish before the next street.
"Then we owe you more."

events.name: The Girl Who Sees Auras
events.intro: A girl sits on a wall and stares just left of you. "Your Pokémon have colours," she says. "Yours is the only party that is a little bit blue." She says it kindly.

success.text: "It is where they are sad, but they like being with you."
She says some of the people in the plaza have one big dark colour. She does not say which.

events.name: Double Booking
events.intro: Two different teams have scheduled the same road. The grunts argue over a clipboard. A favor is owed by whoever helps them sort it out.

success.text: One grunt owes you a favor. The other wants it forgotten.
You stir it into a three-way fight.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Machine of the Week
events.intro: A new machine rolls into the square and a grunt reads from its manual: "It can do something new every week." Today, it is aimed at you.

success.text: A technician and the machine's first demonstration.
You see its one trick and when it uses it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Mark
events.intro: A grunt chalks a small mark on a wall near you and walks off. You are sure it is for you. No fight, nothing to run from; yet.

success.text: A little smeared chalk on your sleeve. Heat eases.

choices.label: Copy it and find out what it means

success.text: A scrawl a few streets on: it is a meeting place.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Curtain Call
events.intro: A theatre troupe, unexpected and loud, finishes a street show with a bow, then looks straight at you. "Final act: audience participation." This is a scene, not a fight.

success.text: A silly bit with a cardboard sword. The crowd cheers and your party is in a fine mood.
A polite round of applause.

events.name: The Postcard Beat
events.intro: A mailman hands you a postcard from someone you met earlier. The picture is of somewhere you have not been yet.

success.text: A line of kindness and a line of warning. You smile at both.
It will be there when you need it.

events.name: Truce by Firelight
events.intro: A campfire, and two grunts of different teams, side by side, not talking. They wave you over. "Just for tonight."

success.text: Soup, a story, and a promise: one favor, once, any time.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Favor Called In
events.intro: The trio, in a delivery van, honks twice. "We said we owed you. We have a thing."

success.text: A neat box of supplies. Nobody asks where from.
A name and a time. You write it down.

events.name: The Bill
events.intro: A grunt hands you a bill for "damage to team property," itemised. He looks as embarrassed as you do.

success.text: He thanks you and slinks off.
A handsome piece of paperwork.
He sighs.

events.name: Wes at the Wall
events.intro: A figure in a long coat sits on a low wall, quietly watching traffic. He nods at you. "Looks like you are going somewhere. Don't let them stop you."

success.text: He gives you a small, sincere smile and a Potion.
"Just someone who got out." That is all he says.

events.name: Chobin's Stall
events.intro: A tiny stall run by a very serious boy named Chobin. He is drawing sketches of Pokémon, five of them. All are well drawn.

success.text: It is a good sketch. Your party approves.
He pretends not to care. He cares.

events.name: Evidence for the Detective
events.intro: A man in a trench coat flashes a badge: Detective Looker, International Police. "I need something concrete to make a seizure legal."

success.text: You hand over your notes. He reads them slowly. "That will do."

choices.label: Ask what he can do for you

success.text: "Watch your back. That is all I can say."
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Wrong Turn
events.intro: You take a wrong turn and end up behind a theatre where an old man is practising his lines to a Pokémon. He pauses. "Oh. Do you want to hear the whole thing?"

success.text: He is very good. A little emotional. Your party is moved.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Errand
events.intro: Your Friend meets you outside a Center with a list. "Can you help me with some errands? It is faster with two."

success.text: Three stops, two jokes, one stolen ice cream. Your party likes your Friend.
You are both home before dark. Fair enough.
"Next time, then."

events.name: The Eve
events.intro: The night before a big thing, your Friend sits beside you on a step. "I am a little scared. I do not want to say that to anyone else."

success.text: You sit together for a long time. It helps.
"You are better than you think." They believe you, a little.
That works too.

events.name: Something of Theirs
events.intro: At the entrance to a place you will have to go in alone, someone has left a small thing on the ground: a button, a wristband, a drawing. Yours, or from someone who loves you.

success.text: It is a small weight in your pocket, and a lighter heart.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Rival Who Stayed
events.intro: Your Friend lags behind to help a stranger with a stuck cart, then catches up, wiping their hands. "What? We had time."

success.text: A good deed done quickly, and a little better for it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Receipt
events.intro: A grunt slips a receipt into your pocket as he passes: itemised, stamped, dated. It records where your rival's Pokémon was taken.

success.text: A thin paper, a long list, and a place you will want to look at.
You cannot unread it.

events.name: A Postcard, Not for You
events.intro: A postcard blown against your shoe, addressed to someone else. Even so, you can read: "Wish you were here."

success.text: You find a post box and drop it in.
It is just a card.

events.name: What the Shadow Remembers
events.intro: In a quiet moment your Shadow Pokémon stops and listens to a bell in the distance. It has heard this bell before.

success.text: A small church garden. The bell stops. Your Pokémon seems steadier.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Cellmate
events.intro: A holding cell at a hideout you are walking through. Someone is in it, not a grunt: a local kid, caught wandering. He looks at you.

success.text: He takes the key and runs for the door, then comes back to say thank you.

choices.label: Leave a Potion and a note

success.text: He will be found by someone kinder.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Dossier Open
events.intro: A quiet night at a rest stop. You open your notebook to the page that lists everyone you have met since you started.

success.text: It is a lot of people. Some you are glad you met.
A line about someone you do not want to forget.

events.name: A Name Given
events.intro: A kid at the rest stop has a Pokémon who has never had a nickname. The kid asks you to name it.

success.text: You choose something warm. The kid grins from ear to ear.
He names it Bob. Bob it is.

events.name: Two Asleep
events.intro: Two of your Pokémon have fallen asleep against each other. The fire is warm.

success.text: They wake rested and a little closer.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: An Offering
events.intro: A memorial wall with shelves of small things: a berry, a feather, a stone. People leave them for Pokémon they miss.

choices.label: Leave a berry for one you lost

success.text: You set it down gently. You feel a bit lighter.
Each one is a small story.

events.name: The Breather Before
events.intro: The last warm room before something big. The kettle is on; the chairs are soft; nobody here is in a hurry.

success.text: A slow night, a hot drink, and a good sleep. You will remember it tomorrow.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Fireside Story
events.intro: A traveller by the fire tells the story of the first time he saw a Pokémon he had only read about.

success.text: It is a good story. It is also a little sad.
He nods, pleased.

events.name: Rain on the Roof
events.intro: A shelter, a tin roof, a fine steady rain. Nobody wants to move.

success.text: You doze off. The rain stops, and you feel rested.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Flask Before the Climax
events.intro: A traveller offers you a flask. "For the road. For whatever is at the end of it." It is just tea.

success.text: It tastes like a long walk.
You tuck it in your bag.

events.name: The Quiet Collector
events.intro: A man with a receipt book sits on a bench in the market. He is not asking for anything yet. He is writing down the names of the shops.

success.text: He tells you which shops he has been told to "insure" and why. You write them down.
You tell three shopkeepers. They thank you and put up a sign.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Hum Under the Tower
events.intro: A hum, low and steady, from the radio tower's base. Pokémon in the yard look up all at once.

success.text: It runs under the road to a grey box with a Rocket logo and a lock. You note the lock.
A bit of cloth and a calm voice. They settle.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Two Hoods, One Cave
events.intro: Two grunts in different coloured hoods share a cave mouth and a cold lunch. They are not talking about it.

success.text: They both say it is going to be a strange one. They both say it quietly.
One of them takes a sandwich. The other pretends not to notice.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Quiet Machines
events.intro: A row of machines on a hillside, humming in unison. A technician in a hard hat is writing numbers in a notebook.

success.text: He is counting something. You count with him.
He gives you a short one. He is proud of the machines.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Speaker in the Square
events.intro: A man on a crate speaks about freedom to a growing crowd. Everyone is nodding. You are not sure why you are uneasy.

success.text: It is beautiful. It does not once say what the Pokémon want.
The crowd turns. He answers. It is still beautiful.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Fashion Show
events.intro: A runway in a plaza. A model walks past in a cloak that looks very much like a team uniform.

success.text: The tag reads FLARE COUTURE, SEASON ONE.
Everyone does. It is a lovely show.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Slow Afternoon
events.intro: A beach, a stall, and two members of rival crews trading stickers. One says: "I am only here for the free coconut."

success.text: A good afternoon. You leave with a sticker.
They both look away and say, very softly, that he is nice.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Crowd Cheers
events.intro: A stadium lot, loud with supporters. A man hands out free flags. The flag has a very small logo in the corner.

success.text: It is a sponsor. The sponsor is not who you think.
Why not? It is a good atmosphere.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Study Hall
events.intro: A class of students argues cheerfully about homework. One of them has a Team Star pin and has never been in a fight.

success.text: He shrugs: "It is a club. We have snacks."
Three hours later you know more about fractions. Your party is entertained.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Second Team's Opinion
events.intro: A grunt from the other team in the region, off duty, offers you his view of things. "The big ones think they are the main show. We are in the second row."

success.text: He tells you where he thinks his own team will go wrong.

choices.label: Ask whose side he is on

success.text: "My own."
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A District Worth Holding
events.intro: A district council asks whether you will stand with them. They have a plan, and a flag, and a very good map.

success.text: They will hold one district for you when the time comes.
A list of five things. You can do two of them today.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Standard or Extended
events.intro: The Last Rest before the end: a room, a lamp, a long table. The keeper of the house asks you, plainly, how you want the last night to go: the short version, or the long one with everything in it. You can say either.

success.text: A single long night, and a clear morning.

choices.label: The long version, with everything in it

success.text: You ask for all of it. The keeper nods.
